========================================
Bare comparison operator as a call argument
========================================

void f(void) {
  assert_int(0, ==, rv);
  assert_size(493, !=, n);
  assert_int(a, <=, b);
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (macro_declaration
        (identifier)
        (macro_argument_list
          (number_literal)
          (identifier)))
      (macro_declaration
        (identifier)
        (macro_argument_list
          (number_literal)
          (identifier)))
      (macro_declaration
        (identifier)
        (macro_argument_list
          (identifier)
          (identifier))))))
